horoscopes.horoscope: Whip up some excitement in your life — put on your walking shoes and go explore some unknown destination, suggests Ganesha. Keep yourself busy, but take care not to overdo anything. Today, you will be the centre of attention in group activities. Nothing to worry about in love life since things seem smooth sailing. You will not only attract your partner but also feel confident in keeping a long-term bond. Sharing stories will be fun and you will make your relationship passionate and adventurous. The day is likely to be challenging from health point of view. You need to avoid anger today because as the day is not good astrologically, anger will affect your emotional balance badly. Overall, it’s a handle with care kind of day. Ganesha advises you to avoid buying anything today. However, if you do, you are unlikely to be happy with the purchase. Today, you need to trust other people’s views on financial matters. A lucky day to pay an utmost attention to major issues at the office. You may be demanding today. Your desire to find a solution to the problems will get you the wanted results even if it demands all your time and energy.

You will find yourself at the crossroads and each turn and twist will come with its share of pros and cons, says Ganesha. Your sentiments may have an ill-effect on your health. You may spend quality time with family members and friends, hoping to shed the burden thrust upon your soul. You may get an opportunity to learn precious things from your sweetheart but may lose because of your rigid mindset. Your relationship may get tensed if you remain firm in opinions with your life partner. Being prudent will help you handle critical situations, suggests Ganesha. You will get lot of satisfaction today, both in personal life and on the professional front, says Ganesha. Your work will be well appreciated in your office. As you will be happy with your work’s appreciation, you will be motivated to take up more work. Today you shall be concerned about your savings and general financial situation. At the same time, you will be on the lookout for chances of earning more through other avenues. Things may not go your way today. Even a single reaction of yours may endanger the situation in the meeting. Therefore, you are advised to remain observant since you may come across adverse or undesirable circumstances. Your views may be opposed by your colleagues.

Today, you are likely to be rather emotional and sentimental, says Ganesha. Your love for performing arts may make you take up lessons in classical music or traditional dance. And much to your delight, your sweetheart will treat you to a surprise candlelit dinner. Your beloved may not make things easier. The difference of opinions may likely to take place. You will try to make your sweetheart understand but may fail to make the situation cool. Use fun and laughter as weapons. This will eventually break the ice a bit, says Ganesha. Your office will be abuzz with activities and you are likely to remain engrossed in solving complicated issues. Your analytical abilities may help you fix problems quickly. You may be asked to work for longer hours. This will make demands on your health. Routine expenses are likely to bother you, feels Ganesha. Your day to day life may become increasingly demanding from financial point of view. You will find no way to control these things. Your research skills may help you fix problems quickly. You no need to get surprised if you are asked to work for longer hours, says Ganesha.

You will be in a joyous mood. You will be de-lighted in whatever task you do. Financial matters will confound you, with even a petty issue causing tension. Ganesha says it will be a colourful day, with happy tidings. You will feel great today as emotional bonding is on the cards. You may expect to receive loving, caring, and nurturing attitude from your partner. You are likely to get emotional support and experience great warmth in the company of your spouse, says Ganesha. This is a favorable day for you today. Your seniors will get impressed with your working skills today. But due to work load, you may feel a bit stressed. Ganesha advises, you to do things which make you happy as it’ll impact your health positively. Today is an auspicious day for buying new stocks, feels Ganesha. You should make the most out of this favourable day in order to increase your financial condition. Quality rather than efficiency should be your target today. Enthusiasm and fun will accompany you throughout the day. Attention to details would be the challenge of the day. Keep an unbiased attitude at the office to let important meetings and deals go well, suggests Ganesha.

The passionate Scorpio might be the master of arousing passionate emotions, but it is the very same emotions that enslave it. But today is different, says Ganesha. You are all set to be lively on this lovely day, as your energy levels touch new peaks. Ganesha guesses it’s your healthy eating habits that are the reason behind this super-charged feeling!. You are ready to feel passionate about your love life. You will let your love mate lead the romantic moves. After all, romantic pleasure is what you want in life. However, you should not force your lover. You will feel happy when you enjoy the course of action smoothly. The day is about making fresh and active old friendship. Besides, there were many issues which you will handle in a very good manner. These issues were seeking your attention for quite some time. Avoid arguing with your superiors, says Ganesha. Substantial financial gains are not foreseen today. Today, you are likely to have more laid back attitude towards money matters. You may not be interested in getting into much of financial calculations. Ganesha feels that you will have to take a backseat at work today. If you try to lead a project or a meeting, you may be get stuck in a Catch-22 situation. Dealing with technical problems might prove difficult for you. Things will be easier if you start working on a small project.

The booster rockets of your ambitions and spirit to work will kick in at the maximum today. Seek recreation after a hard day’s work and look to relax at private parties, social-dos and even weddings, says Ganesha. In love, you will ensure that the difference of opinion doesn’t drive a wedge between you and your partner. You need to take positive approach while handling the issue, feels Ganesha. A good day will come when you try to learn from each other really well. Your mood will help you if you are in R and D. You will be able to organise your ideas in a very good manner and present them in important meetings. This will lead to success and will make you happier. Your mind will be able to dig deeply in the subject of finances. You will be able to figure out flaws in your or your family’s financial management and that’s the key to your success. The day seems relatively good. Interesting projects will in the pipeline. You may be assigned some tasks that may require your immediate attention. You will comfortably take up the assignment and judge thoroughly. You will finish the pending works confidently, feels Ganesha.

Today is the day when you seem to agree with everything that people say, without striking even a note of criticism. It’s just one of those days when you are amazed by all things around you. Such an elastic approach will enable you to be reasonable in your views and sensible in your ways. Ganesha wishes you the very best. An odd conversation with your love mate might make you feel a bit uneasy. Try to stimulate the passion in your sweetheart. You will never find a better time than this. A sweet affair will make the night memorable, says Ganesha. The day is going to be good from health and mood point of view. Besides, today, you will be rewarded for your hard work, which will be like a shot in the arm for you. This is going to make you feel good. Ganesha warns you against expenses today. Planetary positions are such that you will find it difficult – in fact, too difficult to control expenses. It’s not always about you, it’s about need of the hour. Today, you will be rewarded for your hard work, which will bring a positive change in your mindset. However, that doesn’t reduce your burden. You may be assigned more tasks and given bigger responsibilities. Ganesha says that you should never stay away from challenges.

You will find yourself thinking with your heart rather than your head today, says Ganesha. You may not be able to repress your feelings, and you should not even try. But you should be careful about how you express them, particularly in public as people may judge you wrongly on the basis of it, advises Ganesha. The growing intimacy between you and your beloved leads to a memorable evening. You want to enjoy the time laying on the lap of your sweetheart. Emotional stability is in your mind right now, feels Ganesha. With the help your partner, you will strengthen your bond. You will be at your very best today as you will work with extreme dedication. While you work with full intensity, you should see to it that you keep vengeful side in control. You need to take care of all these points to stay happy. Being competitive by nature, other people’s progress will inspire you more to earn good money today. You will keep your secrets with you only and won’t be willing to share your financial profile with anyone. Today’s astral power will make you more determined. You will set goals for the coming month. Ganesha says that you will have sufficient energy to perform the day’s tasks. You will be eventually able to achieve the day’s target or meet the deadline.

No wonder, if you feel like you are stuck in a rut. Your energy level and enthusiasm has gone for a toss due to mundane routine. Unfortunately, your stars too seem to be lazy today, and there’s nothing on the cards that can cheer you up. Ganesha advises to let the day pass calmly and wait for a better tomorrow. Though work may be demanding, spare some time for your loved one. You might cry for keeping in touch with your sweetheart. Ganesha feels that today you need the emotional support from your partner who will not only encourage you but also fill your heart with intense love. Ganesha says health looks favorable now. You’ll feel very lazy in the first half of the day. With your mood swings, you shall even shy away from work. But later on you’ll feel energetic and get back to finish your pending task. Your money will be spent somehow or the other and you won’t be able to control over it. Even if you try, something or the other may crop up which will just make you shell out your funds. This is not a lucky day on the professional front. How much ever you try to finish off the important jobs, you may not succeed. However, this doesn’t mean you should give up. The delay may keep bothering you but if you focus, Ganesha feels you will reach at least the final stage of the project.

Duping the wisest with your extraordinary power of convincing may have been your forte, but you may have to prove yourself all over again, for Ganesha says you will be tested today. This apart, you are likely to find answers to questions lingering in your subconscious mind for long. The outburst of creativity in the second half of the day will draw the attention of your peers, and this will also be the best time to seek their support, advises Ganesha. An uneventful day is on the cards as you are likely to show negligible emotions. This may not reach the heart of your partner. Domestic activities may bore you. Your sweetheart is most likely to impress you. However, you may not satisfy your soul, feels Ganesha. As a team leader, you will be trying to sort out the problems of your team mates. However, you should be tactful while conveying your decision to others. Besides, you may adapt the opinions of another person, who is important in your life. If you are in the business, you will try to increase your contacts by getting into networking. You will realise that good relation pays back so you will start working in that direction and will learn to make friends. Today you’ll need to watch your mouth as almost everything that comes out of it will be taken by others as offensive. It’s a day when you should spend time with yourself provided you don’t be too self-critical. It’s better to work on the projects that need to be finished on time.

For a moment, it seems that you’re swamped with problems. But you are brave enough to deal with any ugly issue that crops up suddenly. Ganesha hints at a romantic evening, which may just be time together in a jacuzzi, or simply preparing a meal together. Pure ecstasy!. There might be situations on the love front wherein you might have to give in. Today, compromising will be the key to happiness, says Ganesha. You may have to mix well with your sweetheart. Taking and sharing responsibilities will boost your relationship. You have to be careful today. You need to avoid taking decisions in haste, says Ganesha. You have to take only well thought out decisions. As for personal life it won’t be a great day. You will struggle with your emotions. Solid foundation of your future income can be laid today. If you are in the business, you will be able to meet all the requirements of clients. You will be able to remain committed to what you are doing. Today you might feel that you are the sole responsible for your company. It may be one of those days when you may feel like correcting everyone at the workplace. You will be safe if you avoid engaging in the hot discussions with your superiors.

All the dieting that you have been undergoing will finally begin to show results, with compliments galore coming your way from your friends. Your energy and enthusiasm levels are likely to be high. A bright and beautiful day waits, says Ganesha. You may desire to spend the evening with your loved ones. You will feel particularly lucky to be in the romantic relationship, you may feel that luck is your companion. Your sweet nature will impress your partner. However, keeping a practical mindset will help you tackle issues. Today, you will be affected by jealousy, feels Ganesha. But this unhappiness is less to do with your rival’s success and more to do with your own failure. You will feel frustrated. However, getting closer to the people around you may be helpful. If you have invested in property, it’s going to get appreciated. Decision is yours if you want to hold on or sell it off. If you sell it today, you will surely have gains. Today your stars are shining brighter than usual. Multi-tasking will interest you while you may remain focused on your primary objectives. The important works will get done. However, make sure that you will maintain the quality of the work, reminds Ganesha.
